{{Top|leg}}
'''Coleoptera''' was an highly-evolved [[Insect/Legends|insectile]] [[Species/Legends|species]], which was believed by [[Xenobiologist/Legends|xenobiologists]] to be nearly [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]]. They employed a complex form of dancing as their primary method of communication.<ref name="DN">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>
